steps:
cat > final.py <<'EOF_FINAL'

import bpy, sys, os
argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
a, b, outp, spf = int(argv[0]), int(argv[1]), argv[2], argv[3]
try: avg = float(open(spf).read())
except Exception: avg = 20.0
sc = bpy.context.scene; ee = sc.eevee
try: bpy.context.preferences.system.gl_texture_limit = "CLAMP_2048"
except Exception: pass
import time
cutoff = 1792921500   # 2026-10-25 09:45 UTC: hard deadline for both halves
remaining = max(600.0, cutoff - time.time())
nfr = b - a + 1
budget = remaining * 0.85 / nfr * 0.6     # per-frame seconds for THIS process (two halves share the GPU)
full = avg * 3.2                            # estimated single-process full-res seconds at 8 samples, raytracing on
levels = [(12, 100, True, True, full * 1.5), (8, 100, True, True, full), (6, 100, False, True, full * 0.62),
          (6, 75, False, True, full * 0.62 * 0.58), (4, 60, False, False, full * 0.62 * 0.4 * 0.6), (2, 50, False, False, full * 0.62 * 0.28 * 0.35)]
smp, pct, rt, mb, est = levels[-1]
for L in levels:
    if L[4] <= budget:
        smp, pct, rt, mb, est = L; break
try: sc.render.use_motion_blur = mb
except Exception: pass
ee.taa_render_samples = smp; sc.render.resolution_percentage = pct
try: ee.use_raytracing = rt
except Exception: pass
print("FINAL LEVEL", avg, smp, pct, rt, mb, budget)
open(outp + "level.txt", "w").write("%s %s %s %s %s %.1f %.1f" % (avg, smp, pct, rt, mb, budget, est))
sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end = a, b
sc.render.filepath = outp
bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)

EOF_FINAL

rm -rf r1 r2 && mkdir -p r1 r2 && date && (/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b $PWD/mc43.blend -P final.py -- 0 1062 $PWD/r1/p1_ $AGENT_HOME/work/2304-mc43-prev2/speed.txt > b1.log 2>&1) & (/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b $PWD/mc43.blend -P final.py -- 1063 2124 $PWD/r2/p2_ $AGENT_HOME/work/2304-mc43-prev2/speed.txt > b2.log 2>&1) & wait; date; cat r1/p1_level.txt; f=$(ls -t r1/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ]; then mv "$f" part1.mp4; else grep -v -i -e bearer -e api_key b1.log | tail -40 > part1.mp4; fi; cat r2/p2_level.txt; f=$(ls -t r2/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ]; then mv "$f" part2.mp4; else grep -v -i -e bearer -e api_key b2.log | tail -40 > part2.mp4; fi; ls -la part1.mp4 part2.mp4
